crossRefs.note: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

people.name: Caiaphas
people.line: High priest during Jesus' ministry and trial

translations.web: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
translations.bsb: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be better if one man died for the people.
translations.kjv: Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
translations.asv: Now Caiaphas was he that gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
